spec: Phase A1A Gate 0A — Negative Fixture Coverage Reconciliation
charter_text_disclepancy_resolution: Phase A0.1R produced 11 fixtures (NF01-NF11). A1A Gate 0 Addendum adds NF12 (worktree.no_secret injection test) to close the 12th charter requirement. No count was changed to 11; no fixture was fabricated. NF12 injects a benign test marker into a tracked file (README.md), patches the validator's fingerprint in-memory, runs check_no_secret_in_worktree, and restores the file in a finally clause.

coverage_matrix.defect_class: Phase A0.1 V2 status-field-misnamed / strict-vs-open+mit ambiguity
coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates ledger in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL with 'claim=99 actual=22'

coverage_matrix.requirement: Ledger count drift — P0-S_open must match actual P0-S strict-open count
coverage_matrix.defect_class: Phase A0.1 V2 derived count bug

coverage_matrix.defect_class: Phase A0.1 V2 did not cross-check per-issue vs explicit_ids; workstream misplacement invisible
coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates ledger in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL mentions A0-P0-021

coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates ledger in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL mentions split_status

coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates ledger in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL mentions reframed

coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates ledger in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL mentions boundary_applied

coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates parity in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL mentions D-05

coverage_matrix.requirement: Parity symmetric thresholds — both ICODER_ADVANTAGE and CORTI_ADVANTAGE must meet class-specific evidence threshold
coverage_matrix.defect_class: Phase A0.1 V2 only checked ICODER_ADVANTAGE direction
coverage_matrix.injection: restore F-03 to CORTI_ADVANTAGE at corti_evidence_grade=E1 (below E7 threshold)
coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates parity in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL mentions F-03

coverage_matrix.requirement: Maturity 7-axis — every china_scenarios entry must have all 7 axes (code_maturity + quality_evidence + partner_validation + regulatory + workflow_closure + security + delivery)
coverage_matrix.defect_class: Phase A0.1 V2 used 5 axes only (no security, no delivery)
coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates maturity in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL mentions CN-01:security

coverage_matrix.requirement: Manifest empty-dir semantics — directory entries (path ends with /) must have exists=true + artifact_count

coverage_matrix.requirement: Manifest storage_mode — every entry must have a legal storage_mode (Public / SPLIT_PUBLIC_RESTRICTED / Restricted)
coverage_matrix.defect_class: Phase A0.1 V2 manifest had no storage_mode field
coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates manifest in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL mentions SECRET_LEAKED

coverage_matrix.requirement: Worktree no plain-text secret — git grep against compromised secret fingerprint must return no matches
coverage_matrix.defect_class: Phase A0.1 V2 did not sweep worktree for secret leaks
coverage_matrix.injection: append benign test marker to tracked README.md; patch validator's SECRET_FINGERPRINT_SUBSTRING in-memory to the marker
coverage_matrix.independent_assertion: fixture mutates README.md (real working-tree file) + patches validator fingerprint in-memory + runs check + verifies FAIL mentions secret found + restores README.md in finally clause
